ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Clusters of high-intensity white circular rosettes concentrated on the distal region of the right lobe; scattered individual white spots and smaller clusters across the medial and distal regions of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Consistent low-amplitude (3-6 pixels) serration along the trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits higher frequency of irregular peaks nearing the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into irregular, textured tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of white ring-like pixel clusters on the right distal fluke margin; sparse detection of similar circular features on the central-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, vertically-oriented high-contrast linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant high-relief, textured pixel masses on both distal tips of the fluke, characteristic of heavy barnacle colonization.
